title: Maximum velocity correct
description: Essential: The student's answer for the maximum velocity must be 18 m/s.

title: Inclined track time correct
description: Essential: The student's answer for the time on the inclined track must be 6 s.

title: Average resistive force correct
description: Essential: The student's answer for the average resistive force must be 180 N.

title: Uses average velocity concept
description: Important: The solution correctly applies the average velocity formula (total displacement/total time) for the entire motion.

title: Links maximum to average velocity
description: Important: The solution correctly states that for uniform acceleration from rest to a maximum and then uniform deceleration to rest, the maximum velocity is twice the overall average velocity.

title: Applies kinematics on incline
description: Important: The solution correctly uses kinematics (e.g., x = (v_avg * t) or v_m^2 = 2a x) to find the time or acceleration on the inclined segment.

title: Applies Newton's second law
description: Important: The solution correctly sets up and solves Newton's second law (mg sinθ - F_f = ma) for the inclined plane to find the resistive force.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: The solution incorrectly assigns signs to acceleration or forces (e.g., adding resistive force instead of subtracting).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution demonstrates consistent use of SI units (m, s, kg, N) throughout the calculation.
